planner_finish.summary: SOLVED in one episode (no reset) at step 13: "pick up the milk and place it in the basket" terminated true. Perception-isolated localization: agentview_high identified the red Dairy Fresh Milk carton (image-left) among the butter/cream-cheese/pudding/OJ/tomato-sauce clutter; median of 4 back-projected hi-res pixels gave (-0.107,-0.240, top z 0.117), wrist-refined to (-0.105,-0.244,0.120) and accepted (<1 cm agreement). Basket cavity was derived as the midpoint of four back-projected rim/wall bands (left y 0.199, right y 0.343, back x -0.060, front wall x 0.063) -> (0.0,0.270), rim z 0.12, deliberately not a rim-biased centroid. Pre-positioned 7 cm over the carton, then pi0_pick "pick up the milk" (max_chunks 20) grasped it and Pi0's trained place drifted to +y (robot-left) exactly over the basket — matching the s0 swap-suite lesson; success flag was false but wrist+agentview confirmed the grasp. The first release did not fire In(): the open fingers had scooped the carton so it rode up with the arm. In-episode recovery: set_gripper +1 re-captured it (qpos 0.027), carried it deeper with gripper +1 into the liner (z 0.21 -> 0.178), released — still no termination. Winning lever: a slow (step_clip 0.005) straight-down move_to to z=0.15 with the gripper OPEN, so the fingers straddled the carton and the palm block pressed it down inside the liner; In(milk, basket_1) fired mid-descent at eef z=0.190. Audit + recipe saved to the online-task directory.
